1.0.0.en: First release. Local control of Vektiva SMARWI window openers with status pushed over WebSocket, a Window dashboard widget, Finetune settings, Flow cards, Insights, and vektiva.online as an optional fallback.

1.0.1.en: While a movement is under way or waiting for the device, the widget shows the requested position instead of briefly jumping back to 100 %. A command deferred until the SMARWI is ready now runs as soon as it gets there, without needing a second press.

1.0.2.en: The readiness of the SMARWI is shown as a sensor instead of a switch on the device tile - fixing and releasing the ridge stays available as Flow actions.

1.0.3.en: The device tile now shows the opening percentage under the name.

1.0.4.en: The app settings are split into Basic and Advanced tabs with clearer headings, and the manual network scan field is gone - pairing finds the subnet on its own.

1.0.5.en: Redesigned the app settings: card layout with matching buttons, an explanation behind every Finetune value, and the connection test prefilled with the address of the paired device.

1.0.6.en: The Device ID for vektiva.online is taken from the device itself - the SMARWI reports it in its status - so the cloud fallback no longer has to be filled in by hand.

1.0.7.en: Real screenshots of the widget in the documentation and as the App Store preview.

1.0.8.en: Resetting the Finetune values now explains what to do when the firmware refuses it, instead of showing a bare HTTP error.

1.0.9.en: Added the App Store description and a dark mode preview of the widget.

1.1.0.en: Optional MQTT support. Pointed at the Vektiva broker or your own one, the app receives the status of the window over the internet as well - something the HTTP cloud API cannot do - and sends commands the same way.

1.1.1.en: Stop now leaves the ridge fixed instead of releasing it, so the next command is not swallowed, and it does nothing while the window is standing still. Pairing also offers devices seen on the MQTT broker, which is how a SMARWI on another network gets added.

1.1.2.en: The widget can release the ridge, so the window can be opened by hand, and fix it again afterwards.

1.1.3.en: The Finetune values live in one place now - the app settings, where they have sliders and an explanation each. The device settings keep only the connection.

1.1.4.en: Renamed the Fix tile to Holding, which is what it reports: whether the motor is holding the sash right now. Releasing the ridge is a separate thing and shows up under Readiness.

1.1.5.en: With the ridge released the widget no longer claims to know the position: it says the ridge is released and hides the percentage, because the device cannot follow a sash it is not holding.

1.1.6.en: A released ridge is remembered by the app, because the SMARWI does not report the state of its clamp. The button no longer flips straight back to "Release the ridge", and the release is forgotten as soon as the device moves the window or holds it again.

1.1.7.en: A released ridge stays released in the widget. The device raises its holding flag for a few seconds right after the release, which used to reset the state on its own.

1.2.2.en: The ridge button and the banner had their wording the wrong way round: the button offers to release the ridge, and the banner appears only while it is released.

1.2.3.en: Stopping the window part way no longer leaves the old percentage on screen. The SMARWI counts from the frame sensor and cannot say where the sash ended up, so the position is withheld until the next full open or close.

1.3.0.en: Stop moved from the up/down/idle control to a button of its own, so the device tile no longer shows two ways to move the same window. New App Store artwork, a driver icon of its own, and a widget preview drawn rather than screenshotted.

1.3.1.en: The App Store image now shows the window tilting into the room, which is how a SMARWI window opens, with the unit on the sash and its ridge drawn back up to the frame.

1.3.2.en: The Ridge tile reported "Removed" whenever the window got blocked, because it was showing the readiness flag instead of the ridge sensor - a locked window now says Blocked while the ridge still reads Inserted. The Flow action "Open to X %" became a plain "Open the window"; a partial opening belongs to the "Set the position to" card.

1.3.3.en: A window that had been locked to the frame stayed stuck: the SMARWI latches that error and refuses to move until it is reset, and 1.3.2 stopped sending the reset. Opening the window now clears the error first and then moves, and Stop clears it on its own.
